purpose: Declarative contracts for project identity aliases and rename lifecycle operations.

tools.name: list_project_aliases
tools.description: List active project identity aliases. Use this to see which historical project names resolve to a canonical project id.

project_id.description: Optional project id or alias to scope the alias list.

tools.name: rename_project
tools.description: Rename a project identity as a normal lifecycle operation. Defaults to dry-run; set apply=true to rewrite structured SQLite project references and create aliases.

old_project_id.description: Historical project id or working name.

apply.description: Apply changes. False returns a dry-run report.

ensure_alias.description: Create canonical and legacy alias rows.

reason.description: Reason stored with the alias/update report.
